high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "wehavethedata." The post was made 12 hours prior to the screenshot being taken, as indicated by the timestamp at the top of the post. The post features a map of South Asia, specifically highlighting the subcontinental rivers. The map is color-coded with different shades representing various river basins or hydrosheds. The title of the map is "Sub Continental Rivers," and it credits the data source as "Hydrosheds" and mentions "@PythonMaps" as the creator or contributor.
